Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.1: General Guidelines > Application of Guideline

Required findings: Presence of traumatic spinal fractures or dislocations (with or without neural compression) when instability is present or decompression of the spinal canal is anticipated to result in iatrogenic instability
Presence of infection (e.g., discitis, epidural abscess, osteomyelitis) when instability is present or debridement and/or decompression is anticipated to result in iatrogenic instability

Primary or metastatic neoplastic disease causing pathologic fracture, cord compression, when instability is present, or resection and/or decompression is anticipated to result in iatrogenic instability
A condition otherwise meeting criteria listed in the applicable procedure section(s) with documentation of severe debilitating pain and/or dysfunction to the point of being incapacitated
Imaging findings noted in the applicable procedure section(s) are required
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.1: General Guidelines > Urgent/Emergent Indications/Conditions (TOC: S4.3.2)

Non-Indications: Cases where the patient has not completed provider-directed non-surgical management, unless an urgent/emergent condition is confirmed
Cases where the patient has not provided proof of smoking cessation, unless an urgent/emergent condition is confirmed

Cases with unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders), unless an urgent/emergent condition is confirmed
Repeat procedures performed within the prohibited time frame, unless an urgent/emergent condition is confirmed
Important criteria & exceptions: The determination of medical necessity for the performance of lumbar fusion (with or without osteotomy) is always made on a case-by-case basis

For confirmed urgent/emergent conditions, the following criteria are NOT required: provider-directed non-surgical management, proof of smoking cessation, absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders, and time frame for repeat procedure
Documentation required: Imaging findings noted in the applicable procedure section(s)
Documentation of severe debilitating pain and/or dysfunction to the point of being incapacitated (for urgent/emergent conditions meeting other criteria)
Proof of smoking cessation (for non-urgent/emergent cases)
Documentation of provider-directed non-surgical management (for non-urgent/emergent cases)
Documentation of absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (for non-urgent/emergent cases)
